description: Legal-document-template commons (法律文書雛形) — weaves fair, neutral, openly-licensed legal-document templates (contracts / agreements / covenants), decomposed into reusable clauses, into the kotoba Datom log, and binds every clause to the ACTUAL public statute it cites or is mandated by (:cites-statute / :mandated-by 縁). Surfaces integrated statutory groundedness over a template, routed to PUBLIC RELEASE (anyone may use it freely), and executes contracts electronically via the existing esign subs...
